visual_description: A precision brush with a slim, ergonomic wooden handle. The ferrule (the metal part) is bright silver. The bristles are long, soft natural fibers, shaped into a fine point. It is shown at a 45-degree angle as if dusting a surface.

constraints.material: Polished mahogany wood handle; soft cream-colored bristles.
constraints.logic: Used for the 'final reveal' of a specimen.
